sections.note: The journey from the Priory to the reception is approximately 4.5 miles (7.3 km) and takes around 15 minutes by car. Please allow additional time for parking and travel directly to the hall after the service.

sections.heading: Travel & staying over
sections.intro: Useful information for guests travelling to Malvern

items.heading: Parking
body: The best parking for Great Malvern Priory is at Waitrose, where free parking is available for up to three hours.
The reception hall has its own car park with ample parking.

items.heading: Arriving by rail
body: Great Western Railway (GWR) runs a good service from London Paddington to Great Malvern.

items.heading: Staying overnight
body: The Great Malvern Hotel is reasonably priced and within walking distance of Great Malvern Priory.
There are lots of nice places for breakfast in the town.

items.heading: Taxis
body: Uber generally works well in Malvern, although pick-up times can be longer than in larger towns and cities.
If you would rather use a local firm for the 22:30 carriages, options include Smith Taxis, Access Taxis and BNS Travel.

items.heading: A Sunday walk
body: If you are staying in Malvern on Sunday and fancy a walk, the climb from the town centre to the top of Worcestershire Beacon is rewarding but challenging, with some steep sections.

If you are driving and would prefer something gentler, Black Hill car park on Jubilee Drive is the best shortcut. From there, a short path with a gentle gradient leads up to the ridge and panoramic views.

links.label: Directions to Black Hill car park

items.heading: Food
body: Welcome drinks and canapés will be served from 14:00. A buffet meal will begin from 15:00.
The buffet will feature traditional Lebanese and Moroccan cuisine, with vegetarian options available.
Some dishes may contain nuts, and we cannot guarantee that any dish will be completely free from nuts or traces of nuts. Guests with nut allergies should take particular care.

items.heading: Drinks
body: Soft drinks, tea and coffee, as well as wine, local beer and local cider, will be available. If you have a favourite alcoholic drink that is not listed, please feel free to bring your own.

items.heading: Seating
body: Seating at the reception will be informal. Please choose any available table, except tables marked Reserved

items.heading: Children
body: Children are warmly invited. The reception hall has a large sports field, and there should be some balls and basic games available.

items.heading: Dress code
body: There is no particular dress code — please wear whatever makes you feel comfortable and ready to celebrate. It is a wedding, and the ceremony takes place at Great Malvern Priory, a beautiful Church of England church, so please bear the occasion and setting in mind.

items.heading: Photography
body: Visit the Photo Guestbook table during the reception, take an instant photo, add it to our scrapbook and leave us a message.

sections.heading: Gifts & final notes
body: Your presence at our wedding is the greatest gift to us.
If you would like to give us something, we love food and drink treats, things for the house, or any other gift you think we might enjoy.
If you are stuck for inspiration, we have also set up a gift list with The Wedding Shop.

sections.heading: We cannot wait to celebrate with you.
